opening.argument: The central purpose shown is an investigation and test of a purported tech-support scammer: the title presents the creator as “Posing As A Rival Tech Support Scammer,” while the description explains that the video examines how the caller would defend himself against another “scammer” trying to sell services to grandma. The $290 demand, computer-access claim, and instructions concerning the computer occur within the depicted call, culminating in the confrontation, “You thought you were scamming me the whole time Jack.” They are not offers made by the creator to viewers, and the records do not show viewers being asked for credentials or money. The closing subscription request is ordinary audience engagement, consistent with an anti-scam warning and investigation.
